verdict.rationale: The only localized-edit evidence is mask-based re-editing that preserves unmodified regions, but it is documented for Image 3.0 Omni (still images), not for existing video clips. Generic claims about refining and editing videos in post-production do not show element replacement or restyling inside a video frame. No evidence shows Kling replacing or restyling an element in an existing video while keeping the rest of the frame intact.

support.subject: As a creator, I can replace or restyle an element inside an existing video while the rest of the frame stays intact

citations.quote: Mask-based local re-editing preserving unmodified regions during targeted changes (Image 3.0 Omni)
